title: AI7 Provider Processing Policy v17
description: Validates the exact ordinary-production authority contract: v15 plus AI7's platform tools on the rules that may research (review including 事实核查 and 学术道德与引用, writing, the three evaluation contracts): websearch through the backend the editor configures with their own key among the five shipped backends (an unconfigured backend cannot be selected), AI7 webfetch bounded by citations, a 128-round-trip breaker and one query per Run unit; baseline analysis, editorial dialogue, 润色, conflict regeneration and enrolled background analysis stay without web; 出版政策与风险 stays outside every rule; no cache, hosted, CI or Series Knowledge origin.

clarification.description: Model-initiated clarification: at most one question per unit; the unit waits for the editor while other units continue; after the timeout the question counts as unanswered and the Run Report discloses it.

authorityOrigin.description: Review admits standard-direct and default-execution-rule origins: a newly user-initiated Task may use review quick start under its matching active Default Execution Rule. Background enrollment, schedules, import triggers and cross-Run dispatch remain refused here.

platformTools.description: AI7's platform tools for this rule: websearch through the one backend the editor selects among the five shipped backends (default the first, the recorded top rank) with the editor's own key in that backend's search-connection slot; a backend without a configured key cannot be selected for a Run, and configuring a backend alone authorizes no transmission; webfetch at most 5,242,880 bytes and 30 seconds per page, only for addresses the model cites; a breaker that ends a unit after 128 consecutive tool round trips with 联网核查未完成; one search query per Run unit; tool results are public-or-synthetic. Only the model's own query reaches the search host.

authorityOrigin.description: Only an active matching Background Analysis Enrollment admits this origin, and each dispatch creates one exact Run; no new Task is required and a Default Execution Rule, a provider setup, an import or an artifact enablement never creates an enrollment. Dispatch happens in idle or quiet time while the editor's application is running.

clarification.description: A background Run may ask the same single clarification question per unit; the unit waits (holding no background slot) while other units continue, and an unanswered question ends as 不回答 after the timeout, disclosed in the Run Report.

authorizationPreconditions.description: The enrollment must state a tokens ceiling; an unset ceiling is refused here although foreground Runs may leave theirs unset. A Series or all-Books enrollment splits that ceiling equally across the Books it schedules, the remainder going to the first Book in the scope's Book order. Background Runs hold at most capacity minus one concurrent slots, so a foreground Task always keeps one.
